title: Specify LIMR artefacts, modelling method and metadata
requirements:
- Require publication of machine-readable validation artefacts where feasible
- Require artefacts in the LIMR to follow a declared, uniform modelling method to avoid divergent valid models
- Address divergence where the same concept is modelled in incompatible but conformant ways
- Have the LIMR publish version and hash, the CDSE verify loaded logic and record executed-content identity
- Align LIMR Req 10's status with Table 3.5's no-reinterpretation claim
- Define reusable model components and avoid copied fragments
- Consider requiring a declared, uniform modelling method for artefacts in the LIMR
- Model binding strength, purpose, version and expression handling
